zh: 想一起玩的话：捉迷藏、踢毽子、跳绳；夜里还有追萤火虫和拉圈圈唱歌。
en: We can play hide and seek or shuttlecock or jump rope. At night we can chase fireflies or sing in a circle.

zh: 仓库里没有能递的零嘴。
en: There’s nothing in the warehouse to offer as a snack.
Pick a snack from the warehouse
She can’t step away just now.
There’s no clear way to reach her right now.

zh: 离线最多让原本不饿的伙伴变得有点饿。
en: Companions who weren’t hungry can get a little peckish while you’re away.

zh: %d 株已浇水的作物在这段时间里成熟了。
没有新成熟的作物；没有自动收成。
en: Nothing new ripened. Nothing was harvested.
Diary pages from before you left: %s.

zh: 没有留下新的离线日记。
en: No new diaries were written offline.

zh: 伙伴们还在各自的位置。
en: Everyone is still where you left them.
There’s a note for you in the mailbox.

zh: 我给你留了个位置。回来就好，其他事慢慢说。
en: I saved you a seat. I'm glad you're back. Everything else can wait.

zh: 傍晚或夜里，和伙伴在围炉坐下再说吧。
en: Let’s talk when we’re sitting around the fire at dusk or after dark.

zh: 今晚已经说过一回夜话了。
en: We’ve already had our fireside talk tonight.
That night you told me “%s.” I remember.

zh: 明早去广场一起看日出
en: Watch the sunrise at the plaza tomorrow
Meet by the campfire tomorrow evening
It’s time for our little plan.
You came. I’d been looking forward to it.

zh: 昨天没等到你。下回再一起吧。
en: I missed you yesterday. We can try again another time.
Our first little pat on the head.
The first time you helped her feel better.

zh: 我们第一次守住了约定。
en: The first time we kept a promise together.
